claims.statement: Dickson, Sabine, Christian (eds.) 2007, Guide to Best Practices for Ocean CO2 Measurements, Ch. 5 sec. 7: the formulas for K0 (Weiss 1974), K1 and K2 (Lueker et al. 2000), KB (Dickson 1990), KW (Millero 1995), total boron 0.000416 S/35 (Uppstrom 1974), and the printed check values at S 35, 25 C: ln K0 -3.5617, log10 K1 -5.8472, log10 K2 -8.9660, ln KB -19.7964, ln KW -30.434. The Guide's KW carries a -0.015 constant-term shift that approximates the SWS-to-total conversion.

Jessen, Jakobsen, Looms, Ambus, Postma, 'Subsoil acidity causes long delays in inorganic carbon sequestration by Enhanced Weathering' (preprint; recorded in the preregistration as arXiv 2607.01835, not re-verified from the PDF text), Supplementary Text 2: inputs Delta-beta = (0.55-0.2)+(0.12-0.03) = 0.44, eps 0.3, rho 2.65, eps_w 0.1, dc 0.80 meq/L, v 5 m/yr; printed dq 45.4 and 131.3 meq/L, R 58 and 165, v 8.7 and 3.0 cm/yr, '12-34 yr/m'. The printed dq values are not mutually consistent with dq proportional to CEC (ratio 0.3458 versus 0.56/1.6 = 0.35).

Closed form and monotonicity test: at fixed fCO2, eta = (dDIC/dh)/(dTA/dh) = N/D = (h+2K2)/((h+4K2)+h^3 R/(C K1)), R = BT KB/(KB+h)^2 + KW/h^2 + 1. The interval sign test 2 C K1 K2/h^2 > |Q| is a sufficient condition for d eta/dh > 0 by the Lean identity (A) given the hand check that N', D' are the h-derivatives (producer and auditor, NOT in Lean). Numerical support (Tier X for the points): closed form versus 50-digit numerical derivative of DIC(TA), producer 50 points worst relative 1.3e-16, auditor 3 points including both extreme corners to 5e-9 (limited by the derivative step).

Producer's rigorous outer enclosures of eta over the box T [0,30] C, S [30,38], fCO2 [280,560] uatm, TA = (S/35) TA35, TA35 [2200,2400] umol/kg (mpmath.iv, 30 digits, branch-and-bound, evaluation cap 3000 reached with about 1300 live cells so the bounds are sound but not tight): U0 (constants as printed) [0.703565, 0.955707], rounded inward [0.7036, 0.9557]; U1 (pK +-1 sigma) [0.6826, 0.9618]; U2 (+-2 sigma) [0.6616, 0.9676]. One-sided point bounds: the true range contains a value >= 0.94428 and a value <= 0.74271 (U0). Given the Guide-printed constants (CK2-L-0001); not replayed in Lean. U2 was produced with an earlier root-finder seed (h bracket verified by interval signs, so rigor is unaffected; the archived file hash belongs to that earlier code); re-run 2026-10-31 with the current code on cores 6,7: identical enclosure and point bounds, the JSON differs from the archived file only in the 'seconds' field (data/rerun_U2/).

Independent AI re-check with own code and a different method (mean-value form for the constants, plain interval eta = 1/(1+g) on 4 h-pieces, adaptive bisection, TA widened outward by 1e-12 relative; mpmath.iv at 30 digits, the SAME interval library as the producer's): U0 [0.7036, 0.9557]: every cell inside (223 cells); U1 [0.6826, 0.9618]: 167 cells; U2 [0.6616, 0.9676]: 140 cells; tighter U0 [0.7410, 0.9455] certified (3039 cells); [0.7425, 0.9445] not certifiable (101 corner cells unresolved at depth 30, interval dependency).

Controls, run before the headline: P1 PyCO2SYS 1.8.3.4 inside the U0 neighbourhood enclosure 500/500 (float agreement worst 4.1e-5; point-box 0/500 expected); P1b with the Guide's KW and BT fed to PyCO2SYS 100/100 (worst 6.7e-10); P2 closed form versus 50-digit derivative worst 1.3e-16; P3 five Guide check values reproduced; N1 K1/K2 swapped 100/100 excluded; N2 wrong-sign borate 100/100 excluded; N3 pCO2 unit error rejected by the box guard; N4 corrupted K1 coefficient rejected (log10 K1 -6.1826); N5 planted sorry/axiom caught (CK2-A-0002). Auditor: 202-point PyCO2SYS cross-check worst relative 4.4e-5 (1.4e-10 with matched KW, BT).

Jessen arithmetic (partial pass, P4): with the printed inputs, dq = 45.71 and 130.59 meq/L, R = 58.13 and 164.24, v = 8.60 and 3.04 cm/yr, 11.6 to 32.8 yr/m. R and v agree with the printed 58, 165, 8.7, 3.0 within printed rounding; the printed dq (45.4, 131.3) have ratio 0.3458 but dq is proportional to CEC, requiring 0.35; the printed '34 yr/m' is not reproduced (32.8 from the inputs, 33.3 even from the printed 3.0 cm/yr). Exact rational instances in Lean (CK2-A-0001). No claim about the real experiment.

HEADLINE. In a carbonate-borate-water equilibrium model on the total pH scale with constants as printed in the Dickson-Sabine-Christian Guide (primary papers not read), the uptake per unit alkalinity eta = dDIC/dTA at fixed fCO2 lies in [0.7036, 0.9557] over the seawater box (rigorous interval enclosure, loose; the auditor also certifies [0.7410, 0.9455]); the true range contains a value >= 0.94428 and a value <= 0.74271; 0 < eta < 1 (Lean, Tier A). The value eta ~ 0.8 is long known; no tonnes, climate effect, ecological safety or deployment claim. Model-conditional on the total scale and the stated TA definition. PARTIAL outcome.

Point values and samples, not certificates: auditor's attained eta ranges at the two extreme corners over all 32 sign combinations of +-1 sigma (+-2 sigma) in pK: [0.7374, 0.9468] (U1), [0.7322, 0.9491] (U2), i.e. attained shifts of about 0.005 and 0.010 (the U1/U2 enclosures' extra width 0.02/0.04 is mostly interval overestimation); finite-difference signs on a 5^4 grid and a 7^4 grid range [0.742708, 0.944283] (eta decreases with T, S, TA35, increases with fCO2: numerical observation); omitted terms over 202 PyCO2SYS points: sulfate+fluoride +2e-6 to +7.2e-5, phosphate 2 + silicate 100 umol/kg -0.0004 to -0.0015 (up to -0.0022 at 3/150), Lee 2010 boron -0.0004 to -0.0007 at the corners; part (b) dilute/soil water pH thresholds (eta<0.01 below pH ~4.5-4.7, eta<0.1 below ~5.0-5.2, eta=0.5 at ~5.5-5.7 at 420 uatm; freshwater K1, K2 from PyCO2SYS, KW at S=0 carries the seawater -0.015 shift).
